# Stream: [Feature title — e.g. Order Export]

> Work-stream manifest. Created by `brainstorming` at stream start (greenfield), or by
> `plan-writing` when it opens a **stream-light** stream for brownfield work; each stage skill
> appends its artifact row and updates the board. `lane:` is descriptive metadata only —
> `brownfield` marks a stream-light stream (opened without REQUIREMENT/DESIGN), but gate authority
> stays with `hooks/lib/sdlc_state.py`, never this marker. **`status: done` is the ONLY thing that
> closes a stream** — it is authored, never inferred from checkpoint/verdict state (a stream-light
> stream that never writes an SRS/TECH could otherwise never close). The **Gate Status** zone is
> DERIVED — regenerated by `handoff` / `session-init` from `sdlc_state.py`; **never hand-edit it**
> and it is never a second source of truth. This file is the orphan/gap surface: an artifact not
> linked here is an orphan; a stage missing its expected artifact is a gap.

## Artifacts (membership — authored)

Every linked artifact also carries `stream: [slug]-[YYYYMMDD]` in its own frontmatter (the persistent
cross-artifact identity carrier).

| Stage | Artifact | Path | Status |
|-------|----------|------|--------|
| Brainstorm | BRAINSTORM | `brainstorm/BRAINSTORM.md` | [status — e.g. done] |
| Requirement | SRS | `requirements/SRS.md` | [status — e.g. pending] |
| UI design | SCREEN | `requirements/SCREEN.md` | [status — e.g. n/a] |
| Basic design | BASIC | `design/BASIC.md` | [status] |
| Detail design | TECH | `design/TECH.md` | [status] |
| Plan | PLAN | `plan/PLAN.md` | [status] |
| Implement | DEV log | `work-logs/DEV-[YYYYMMDD].md` | [status] |
| Review | REVIEW + VERDICT-REVIEW | `reviews/REVIEW-[YYYYMMDD].md` (+ `reviews/VERDICT-REVIEW.json`) | [status] |
| Security | SEC + VERDICT-SECURITY | `security/SEC-[YYYYMMDD].md` (+ `security/VERDICT-SECURITY.json`) | [status] |
| Unit test | UTR + VERDICT-UNIT | `test-reports/UTR-R[n].md` (+ `test-reports/VERDICT-UNIT.json`) | [status] |
| Integration test | ITR + VERDICT-INTEGRATION | `test-reports/ITR-R[n].md` (+ `test-reports/VERDICT-INTEGRATION.json`) | [status] |
| Retro | RETRO | `retro/RETRO-[YYYYMMDD].md` | [status] |

Add or remove rows to match the stream's actual scope; delete a row for a stage this stream skips.

## Board (task decomposition — authored, skill-maintained)

Coarse phases live here; fine-grained tasks live as `[ ]` / `[x]` checkboxes in the PLAN's phase files.
Status is mutated by the stage skill that owns the work (direct markdown edit — no external CLI).

| Phase | Task | Status |
|-------|------|--------|
| [phase — e.g. Implement] | [task — e.g. Backend export service] | [ ] |
| [phase — e.g. Implement] | [task — e.g. CSV formatter] | [ ] |

## Gate Status (DERIVED — regenerated from `sdlc_state.py`; do NOT hand-edit)

<!-- Regenerated by handoff / session-init. Gate authority is the glob (sdlc_state.py), not this line. -->

```
Feature [slug]: REQUIREMENT pending | DESIGN pending | REVIEW pending | SECURITY pending | UNIT pending | INTEGRATION pending
Next: [/cbr-<next-stage> <slug>]
```

Closing the stream (`status: done` above, authored by the user's confirmation) is a separate,
manual step — this ladder can be all-`pending` on a stream-light stream that's already closed.
